extracted.name: Nuoc Cham (Vietnamese Dipping Sauce)
extracted.description: This traditional Vietnamese dipping sauce is made with fish sauce, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, and Thai chile peppers, the amounts of which can be adjusted to personal preference.
instruction_lines: Stir the sugar and warm water together in a bowl until the sugar dissolves completely; add the fish sauce, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, Thai chile peppers, and green onion to the mixture.
